summary: Qualified the combined I01e2a/I01e2b real-image Compose lifecycle from clean locked builds: explicit migration/readiness, retained restarts, repeated empty/failure resets, old producer/connection removal, private administration/egress isolation and exact cleanup. Two final concurrent real Testcontainers witness qualifications pass with 2223 and 2244 continuous sentinel/transaction probes and both cleanup directions. Repaired a test-only WSL/Docker JDBC startup obstacle with OS-reserved explicit loopback publication and bounded startup-only connection readiness, retaining failed experiments and passing retry/timeout/error/30-startup regressions. All 37 service/six shared, 18 controller/11 adapter/21 fixture-ledger tests and unchanged 875-item coverage pass. Only I01e2 closes; I01e/I01 integration, I01f Android/storage/Appium, independent B1 review and external gates remain open.

implementation: Clean no-build-cache strictly locked normal server image build regenerates jOOQ from real migrated disposable PostgreSQL and packages the installed distribution; normal pinned synthetic adapter build validates fixtures and retains exact source/base/package/license identities. Both images remain local and unpublished. Final identity check retains image manifests and proves installed library/generated schema hashes still match.

Two complete final composeIsolationTest executions each exercise fresh provision/readiness, explicit migration, real writer/schema ownership, retained backend/database/adapters/all restarts, all 144 served provider hashes/configured art origins, private administration/source fault independence, blocked external IP/DNS egress, Docker29 internal-publication measurement and actual loopback relays. Repeated dirty resets terminate observed old PostgreSQL/SMTP DATA connections, remove old processes/namespaces before store replacement, restore pinned v1/default/empty baseline and recover explicit failed migration/startup/readiness without issuing a dirty handoff. Foreign shared mounts are refused before shutdown.

Separate real Testcontainers PostgreSQL transactions and sentinels retain connectivity/data during 2223 and 2244 continuous probes across the final reset/failure suites and Compose cleanup. Reverse startup/migration/cleanup preserves live Compose IDs/readiness. Independent complete lifecycle checker also passes initial migration/startup failure, foreign target and cleaned-instance refusal. Original unrelated resource inventory matches after clean image builds, service tests and every final lifecycle run.

Test-only OwnedPostgres now uses OS-reserved explicit 127.0.0.1 publication for every test, retaining stable restart ports without wildcard/random Docker publication. Bounded JDBC startup retries only connection-class SQLStates, with one-second socket/connect timeouts and a ten-second deadline; normal connection() and operations remain non-retrying. Existing restart callers use the same default helper. New approved-path tests assert 30 real fresh starts, actual loopback-only bindings and SQL round trips; controlled transient-startup recovery, bounded persistent failure and immediate authentication/SQL/unknown-state failure are checked. No runtime/config/build/dependency input changed.

All 37 service and six shared tests pass with no skips after the final repair, including existing real migration, ownership, concurrency, DB outage and actual service process/SIGTERM regressions. Controller (18), adapter (11), fixture/ledger (21), synthetic catalog validation, unchanged coverage accounting and module boundaries pass. Exact passing and failing XML is retained losslessly as JSON-encoded original bytes, never whitespace-rewritten.

e2e/README.md records combined qualification and reproducible local commands, failure provenance, loopback-only test helper and remaining parent/device/product/release obligations. State advances I01e2 only; children, ancestors, B1 review, authorization/runner and gates are unchanged.
troubleshootingHistory: Initial service/shared regressions passed. The first integration run completed the reset suite and 2246 witness probes, but a new reverse-cleanup Testcontainers PostgreSQL connection reset during SSL negotiation after container ready logs. Exact resources cleaned and original inventory matched. The run's helper then also refused to label failed XML passing; that original failure/output and XML remain diagnostic evidence.

Testcontainers PostgreSQLContainer 2.0.5 upstream source inspected at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-java/2.0.5/modules/postgresql/src/main/java/org/testcontainers/postgresql/PostgreSQLContainer.java: its waitUntilContainerStarted checks two ready log messages, not JDBC. Direct cache inspection was denied by the existing external-directory boundary; it was not bypassed. Thirty initial startup trials did not reproduce the failure. A bounded startup-only retry was implemented with deterministic tests, but the following whole service run reproduced one persistent reset for ten seconds, disproving retry alone as sufficient. Its original failing XML/output is retained.

Added safe failure diagnostics comparing direct bridge and published JDBC paths; 30 and 150 subsequent startup trials and a full suite did not reproduce it. These are diagnostic experiments, not proof the host problem disappeared or passing substitutes for final validation. Final repair additionally reserves the actual loopback bind port at the OS and explicitly publishes only that address, applying the already evidenced WSL exact-bind-address requirement to the integration DB helper. This avoids Docker-selected wildcard/random port allocation and retains normal restart semantics. All final required checks then pass, including two full integration runs. A general internal Docker/WSL root cause was not proven; no global networking/tool settings or security grants were changed.
limitations: I01e2 only is implemented, not independently reviewed. I01e/I01 combined qualification and I01f Android-to-loopback routing, fresh app data, actual storage instrumentation and Appium remain pending. No account/deck/game/Canvas UI acceptance or complete T-551/T-630/T-662 product journey is claimed.

Local Docker29.8.2/Compose5.6.0 Linux/WSL amd64 only; remote daemons, other network backends, arm64/current/tablet/physical device and signed upgrade qualification are not inferred. Test-only loopback reservation is not a production networking change. Initial failing checks stay diagnostic and are superseded only by the explicit final post-repair validations, not relabeled passes.

The backend has only writer/singleton recovery. Future account/game/inbox/outbox/mail/push workers must extend readiness/reset/quiescence/retained recovery before their scenarios. No fake worker/backend, user-action/seed API, external provider/relay, paid resource, deployment, subagent or another loop was used.

Owned Compose/Testcontainers containers, volumes, networks, old connections, forwarders, ports and temporary secrets are removed; original unrelated inventory is unchanged. Private diagnostic directories and local build/image caches may remain. Every referenced command output, failed/passing XML and support helper is committed; all external gates remain unverified.
